violations.message: MovementController.step(): triggerless branch guarded by 'evasionWithinStuckPeriod || advancedBeyondStuckDist' follows event-triggered branch(es): event instanceof chemical_detector.event.InputEvent.stop, event instanceof chemical_detector.event.InputEvent.resume — in the extracted model both are enabled together
violations.directive: An event-triggered branch followed by a TRIGGERLESS branch in the same else-if chain has no counterpart in RoboChart: the Java takes only the first branch, but the extracted transitions form an unguarded external choice and the triggerless one is enabled whenever its data guard holds — including when the event is present. RoboChart has no event-absence guard.
